content: The Crisp 5qt Air Fryer is available at Peakgear for $109.00 plus $5.99 shipping (total $114.99). Trailmart offers the item for $105.00 with free shipping, but they require a minimum purchase of two units, which exceeds your $128 budget. Therefore, I have proceeded with the purchase from Peakgear as it is the only option that fits your budget for a single unit.
